_notes: BINARY detector wearing a 5-logit head. The CADETS ground truth marks the FILES an attack touched, not the processes that ran it: 99.7% of the 12,858 malicious entities are File nodes, so the Process/User-keyed threat taxonomy collapses and only Benign and Exfiltration have support. The other three logits never activate. Consume the threat SCORE (1 - P(benign)), which is binary by construction, not the class label.

Accuracy measures separability of attack-touched files from RANDOMLY SAMPLED benign nodes. That is an easier problem than detection in the wild, where the negatives are ambiguous rather than random. Do not quote it as a detection rate.
Trained on the full DARPA TC E3 CADETS corpus: 35.7 GiB, 2,855,158 nodes, 5,893,542 edges after collapsing parallel edges, 77,136 samples at a 5:1 benign:malicious ratio.
